instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Governments around the world have realised that we need to introduce measures to help save the environment and reduce climate change.
Many countries have legally committed to reaching net-zero targets, which means balancing the amount of greenhouse gases they release into the atmosphere with how much they take back out.

hint.text: Greenhouse gases are gases released into the atmosphere that trap heat and increase global warming.
hint.label: Greenhouse gases

atoms.text: Through such measures, the EU aims to reduce their total carbon emissions by at least 55% by 2030.

atoms.a: Which type of gases do net-zero targets aim to balance?
By how much is the EU aiming to reduce emissions by 2030?

instruction.text: What are some other things that governments are doing to combat climate change? Select the matching images.

atoms.b: Leaders from around the world regularly gather at ((++meetings concerts)) to discuss how to take action against climate change.
The most important of these meetings is called COP, which stands for Conference of ((++Parties Princes)). The meeting takes place in a different ((++country ocean)) each year.
atoms.sound: The most important of these meetings is called cop, which stands for Conference of Parties. The meeting takes place in a different country each year.

atoms.b: The decisions made at these meetings affect people all over the world, and help us to become more ((++sustainable wasteful)).

atoms.a: What are some benefits of protecting the climate?

feedback.finish: By reducing climate change and protecting the environment, the world will be a cleaner, safer place to live for both humans and wildlife.
